reviews.title: You can’t do anything with this version
reviews.text: Opened it.  Can’t open a script can’t paste a script. Can’t type a script.  Why does this exist?

reviews.title: Unresponsive
reviews.text: How do you expect me to pay $30 for your payed version when your free version is unresponsive and glitchy.

reviews.title: This is trialware, note free
reviews.text: As far as I can tell, you get about 2 minutes of talk time before you get a dialog telling you to pay to continue. They leave this detail out in store description, so I won’t buy it just on the principle.

reviews.title: Awful  software
reviews.text: Terrible  non intuitive  way to load text from clipboard.  Not interested in paying for a full version when this trial version is so bad.

reviews.title: Crashes constantly
reviews.text: I know it’s a free app and the dev wants to push people to the paid version but I wanted to try this out to see if it fits in my established workflow. Literally cannot use the app. Crashes constantly. Absolutely unusable.

reviews.title: Terrible rip off
reviews.text: The app does not function properly. Controls are non-exsistent! Scrolling does not work. No instructions to be found! Trash

reviews.title: Impossible to trial
reviews.text: Before I buy I would like to try it out, even if its promptsmarts own demo text. There is no demo file nor can I add a small file to test the app before I buy.  I have no idea if the app is any good or not.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Was hoping this was going to solve some problems, but it’s garbage. Doesn’t work. Not intuitive. Can’t use all the features. Would be much better just to give us full access to the real app for a 3 day trial. You’re probably losing out on so much money with this setup (assuming the app actually did what it’s supposed to do and in my short sample size it did not).

reviews.title: Lite version
reviews.text: Use of this is not intuitive. I want you to put in a title and then the story and then you hit the play button icon and you assume that it’s recording you well it doesn’t go into settings and you try to turn on video recording it once you upgrade don’t like that if they’re gonna limit you to the length, it should be all the feature

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I decided to try their free versions before possibly buying the $29.99 app. I will also add that I have a brand new pro iPhone, up to date, no issues with any other apps, immediately after opening the app and trying to test out the prompt feature it crashes. Not only on this one but the other one they also have for free. Safe to say I will not be buying the paid version.
